title: Web fixes from the D-043 owner walkthrough (D-056): safe outbound provenance source links in both provenance surfaces + lot-outline visibility root-cause/fix + framing + zoom controls
objective: Execute the three D-056 deliverables exactly. (1) R001 SOURCE LINKS: both provenance surfaces (apps/web/src/components/property/ProvenanceDisclosure.tsx and the provenance rows of apps/web/src/components/rule-evaluation/RuleEvaluationResult.tsx) render a clickable outbound link to the official dataset landing page, built ONLY as constant prefix https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/ + the reproducibility dataset_id AFTER strict token validation (new small lib apps/web/src/lib/provenance-link.ts with its test; the ZoLa-link constant-prefix + validated-token pattern; NEVER an href from request_url or any reflected string - keep urlHost text as the human-readable label or alongside); invalid/absent dataset_id -> today's honest text, no link; target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer. (2) R002 OUTLINE VISIBILITY: root-cause why the live deploy shows a gray canvas with NO visible outline for a single_lot result (owner device, BBL 3022647515 class; canvas + attribution render, so the map boots - suspects to check: the load-event/addLayer wiring against maplibre-gl v6 semantics with an inline empty style, layer paint/visibility, fitBounds framing, coordinate handling; maplibre CSS is imported in layout.tsx - ruled out) and FIX it; additionally the initial framing must show a single tax lot CLEARLY (fitBounds maxZoom 18 renders a ~25x100 ft lot at fingernail size - raise the cap or frame by padding so the lot fills a sensible share of the 320px panel). Display-only discipline unchanged: geometry verbatim, no measurement, camera framing only. Root cause stated with evidence in the producer report; regression-guard test that fails on the old behavior wherever jsdom can express it (extract pure framing/wiring logic if needed - jsdom and Playwright CI lack WebGL). (3) R003 ZOOM CONTROLS: visible zoom in/out buttons via the already-admitted maplibre-gl NavigationControl (showCompass off unless justified), keyboard-accessible, dynamic-import/SSR structure and every no-WebGL/fallback path unchanged. Zero new dependencies; package.json/lockfiles untouched. Producer report saved to project-control/reports/M5-T025-producer-report.md.
